title: Add URL shortening POST endpoint
approach: Introduce a shared in‑memory store (src/store.py) to hold short_code→original_url mappings. Update the existing redirect route to use this store. Implement a new POST /api/shorten route that validates JSON, generates a unique short code, stores the mapping, and returns both the code and full short URL. Register the new route in app.py.
tests_to_write: test POST /api/shorten with valid original_url returns 200 and JSON containing short_code and short_url
test POST /api/shorten with missing original_url returns 400 with error message
test POST /api/shorten with non‑JSON payload returns 400
test that a short_code returned by POST can be used with GET /<short_code> to redirect to the original URL
edge_cases: original_url field absent or not a string
Generated short_code collides with existing code – ensure loop generates a new unique code
request.host_url may end with a slash – normalize to avoid double slashes in short_url
